Let's see if we can get any allies in this fight.
Let's see if we can't strike up a deal.

Let's show these Awakened how veteran soldiers fight.
Let's storm the camp and raise havoc, friend. These explosives will be like Bear's own roar!
Let's take a look at what I can learn.
Let's take a moment to appreciate this blend's bold undertones.
Let's work our contacts, speak with the Scouts—anybody who might be able to help us in our search.

Like my toys? I just got them!
Like the Forged, their spirits are bound to the armor. No idea who made them, but they were fools to leave them behind.
Lion's Arch is one of the top trading ports in Tyria. This city attracts people from all cultures, backgrounds, and affiliations. Perfect for me.
Lion's Arch is where I live, but the sea is my home.
Listen here, Priory people. I have sensor equipment we can use to extrapolate more delicate data from these pillars.
Listen to me! There's another tear here, in the mindscape. Come close. I can help you.
Listen to the merc, kid. We can't risk losing you, too. The best way to honor Eir is to avenge her.
Listen up, cadets. There will be a test on this. And not multiple choice!
Listen, if Kralkatorrik shows his big, scaly snout here, it'd be nice if these people were ready for it.
Livia is contemplating taking things into her own hands.
Livia, a respected friend who fought by my side on many an occasion, will take the Shining Blade into the future with an emphasis on loyalty, courage, and service.

Living and the dead are united at the Necropolis. Bodies are brought from all over the domain to be preserved and judged. Those deemed worthy are given the gift of eternal life to serve our great lord. Praise Joko!
Lob a clump of extinguisher at the ground to slow foes.
Local engineers have developed the technology to become holosmiths. Our thieves have learned a few tricks and are nicknamed deadeyes. And our soulbeast rangers are like no other.
Located to the southwest of The Granite Citadel, **DATA MISSING** was home to the Iron Forgeman.
Long ago, Svanir became corrupted by Jormag's dark magic. Jora bravely killed her brother to protect all norn. She's a hero.

Long ago, the Shining Blade supported Queen Salma the Good as she freed the kingdom of Kryta from the tyranny of the White Mantle. To this day, we carry on the duty to defend Kryta's rulers and her people.
Long enough! Years, at least. And I'm the newest member. They don't let me forget it, though! Always talking about "that one time—oh, right, Hrok, you weren't there for that. Never mind."
Long live King Joko! Is he alive?

Long story. I hated my warband. I felt stifled, and my warband siblings were too thick to think. But I stayed as long as I could. Then my legionnaire's poor judgment ended with us trapped with a handful of lit bombs.
Long we've felled these woods by way of claw and journeykin. No need for outsider magic tricks.
Look at its eyes. This one is fearless!
Look at that! MUP at work.
Look at that—the storm winds are piling the sand up all around us.
Look at these tiny doors! This town was clearly not built for accessibility. I'd thought about settling down here, but I'd just be hunched over all day!
Look at us. We're exhausted. At this rate, the undead will win by outlasting us.
Look inside yourself. Deep down, you know your path.
Look lively, legions! Dominion's come back for more!
Look out—enemy fire heading your way!
Look who's here! But you didn't pay the entry fee. Bouncers! Do your stuff!
Look! I bring you a feast. Eat, eat. Then you help me, yes? Yes!
Look, I found a note. "If you find this, meet me in the place where the raven can't fly."
Look, I hate to be rude, but I'm pretty busy. Come back later? Thanks!
Look, do you need something? I'm incredibly busy here!
Look, pal...it's a figure of speech. If he messes with my chance to get rich, I figure a message needs to be sent. Maybe the next captain will take heed, you know?
Look, you're out of luck. The only lost city I know of is the one that was swallowed up by the sands.
Looking for a challenge? Try and reach the top of the bazaar before time runs out!
Looking for the Durmand Priory? Just follow this road across the bridge and up the hill. And if the Priory scholars seem cranky, that's normal. Don't let them ruin your visit.
Looking to do some exploring? These gates lead to Snaff Memorial Lab, Antidawn Anchorage, and Applied Development Lab. There are three more on the other side of the plaza.
Looking to do some exploring? These gates lead to Snaff Memorial Lab, Antidawn Anchorage, and Applied Development Lab—your own lab, I believe. There are three more on the other side of the plaza.
Looks as if the Mordant Crescent have caught up with me again.
Looks like I'm done here. Now to see if I can reach Taimi. Hm, she said higher ground...
Looks like our cue to head back to Amnoon.
Looks like someone's stalling for time.
Looks like the ancient kings of Orr weren't ready to part with their treasures just yet. With those horrors out of the way, I can get back to exploring.
Looks like the centaurs decided to show up! Their earthcallers can bolster our numbers.
Looks like there's a letter stuck in this crate.
Looks like this place has seen better days, what happened here?
Looks like you were wrong about that one, Haneri.
Looks like you're already registered. Get ready, the race is going to start any moment now.

Losing. They better send our replacements soon, before they lose our world and everything we care about.
Lot of ley-line energy lying around. Let's put it to good use, get those batteries charged.
Love is never easy, although it's usually easi-er.
Lucius, I know you don't like to talk about it because you think I'm too young...
Ludo's glamour spell is disguising you as a Usability Station lab worker.
Lume Archweld is researching the power of the Brandstorm. He's set up capacitors at key locations on in the area. Check on them to make sure they are working properly.

Lure out and defeat Dominion tribunes to gain control of regions and allow United Legion forces to assault the Frost Citadel.

Maintain defenses at the Archen Shoreline bulwark to protect Lion's Arch.
Maintain infrastructure and complete events to raise troop morale, which limits enemy sieges.
Maintain the power levels, or we'll lose this fight!
Maintain your cover while rescuing Gorrik.
Make certain those in the far gladefield have enough supplies.
Make some noise! If the boss goes down, we lose everything!
Make sure the warden doesn't survive. He's done horrible things.
Make sure we have plenty of cores on hand. That golem's job depends on it!
Make sure your glider's in working order. And take time to learn all you can about the local mushrooms.
Makes sense. The life it brought was dark and dangerous, but it was life, nonetheless.
Making it look too easy! Time to switch up activities!
Malchor was the sculptor who shaped the statues of the gods you see across Orr. The process drove him to madness, and he eventually took his life here. A curious thing to commemorate, I think.
Malok, please, we're not asking you to abandon them, but you're hurt also. We have scouts looking for them as we speak.
Many felt imprisoned by our king's wall. Their attempts at escape resulted only in death.
Many in the Pact see themselves as bringers of justice.
Many who have ventured there have gone mad...or worse. Take my advice, stay clear of the ruins. The Durmand Priory is researching the area. Talk to Sophie or Moritz to find out more.
